title: Talking About Salaries
sentences: In my first job I had no idea whether the salary I received was a fair one.
Discussing pay with colleagues was never forbidden, but it was clearly discouraged.
The silence around it was always presented as a simple matter of good manners.
It took me several years to work out whose interests that politeness actually served.
A colleague eventually told me what he earned, and the difference was substantial.
We had joined the company in the same month and were doing very much the same work.
I asked for a raise and received rather less than the amount I had asked for.
The awkwardness of that single conversation lasted for about a week afterwards.
The difference in pay would have lasted for as long as I stayed at the company.
I have given every younger colleague the same advice at the first opportunity.
